thread:
riley: Thanks everyone for joining the runtime roadmap Q&A earlier. Dropping action items and a couple of clarifying questions from PMs.

riley: Main asks: (A) clear canary criteria for kernel v5 rollout, (B) who owns prefix/KV cache purges for model updates, (C) recommended pinning behavior for feature launches, (D) how SLOs map to cost/throughput tradeoffs.

noah: Re: (A) propose automated canary checklist: smoke perf tests, KV prewarm, canary traffic split, degradation guard rails. Can we make that a CI job? @amar?

tess: For (B) ops + feature teams need a simple API. Suggest: feature team triggers cache_invalidate(model, prefix) and we log evictions. I'll write a one-pager.

amar: CI job doable. I'll add an infra pipeline that runs the smoke perf tests and blocks rollout on p95 regressions >10% vs baseline. Also adding a rollback automation if error rate > 0.5%.

kyla: On pinning: expose per-route pin flag that sets routing to specific model_variant. Default: auto route. Warn teams: pinning disables automatic rollout/fallbacks.

riley: Can we get concrete SLO numbers to discuss with Product? Suggest starting points: p99 < 600ms for interactive routes, p95 < 200ms for async batch, but flexible.

noah: Let's tie SLO tiers to routing policy: "low-latency" routes get costier model variants and stricter batch sizes. We'll draft mappings.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-4826 created: canary-ci-pipeline + rollback automation (assignee: amar).

amar: Adding prewarm example to ticket:
```bash
# prewarm KV cache script example
./tools/prewarm.sh --model redwood-lite-v2 --prompts ./tests/seed_list.txt --concurrency 8
```

tess: I'll own the cache API doc and publish by Wed.

kyla: I'll prototype the pinning UI in Console and share mocks by EOD Mon.

riley: Great. Owners recap: noah + riley to coordinate SLO mapping (due Thu), amar infra/CI (PR by Tue), tess cache API doc (Wed), kyla Console mocks (Mon). Ping me for anything blocking.

noah: thumbs up :+1:

amar: Working on it, will post updates to the ticket.

riley: Closing thread but keeping the doc open for comments. Thanks all!
